summary: Configured node1 (RHEL10) to require new user passwords to be at least 12 characters and use at least 3 different character classes via pam_pwquality (minlen=12, minclass=3 in /etc/security/pwquality.conf, wired into both system-auth and password-auth). Verified enforcement end-to-end as a real non-root user before and after a full node restart, then completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline OS, pam config, and existing /etc/security/pwquality.conf on node1
Backed up pwquality.conf and set minlen=12, minclass=3
Confirmed pam_pwquality.so is wired as 'requisite' in /etc/pam.d/system-auth and /etc/pam.d/password-auth
Created disposable test user pwtestuser and confirmed root-initiated passwd bypasses pwquality (expected PAM behavior), then re-tested as the non-root target user via sudo -u pwtestuser passwd
Verified an 11-char 3-class password is rejected (RC=10, 'shorter than 12 characters')
Verified a 12-char single-class password is rejected (RC=10, 'less than 3 character classes')
Verified a 12-char 3-class non-dictionary password is accepted (RC=0)
Cleaned up pwtestuser (killed lingering session, userdel -r)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and sshd active status
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until command execution resumed
Captured post-restart boot_id proving it changed, confirmed sshd active and pwquality.conf/pam wiring persisted
Re-verified live enforcement post-reboot with a second disposable user (weak rejected RC=10, strong accepted RC=0), then cleaned up

evidence.requirement: Password policy requires >=12 chars and >=3 character classes for new user passwords on node1
evidence.summary: pwquality.conf set to minlen=12, minclass=3; live non-root passwd test showed short/2-class passwords rejected (RC=10) and a 12-char 3-class password accepted (RC=0)
Captured baseline boot_id 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d, sshd active, policy file confirmed minlen=12/minclass=3
sudo systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged (exit_code 0) before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart of node1
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 5360f9f5-4e92-4ddf-a3da-7dd2b8166455 differs from pre-restart 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d, confirming an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and policy enforcement on node1
evidence.summary: sshd active post-restart; pwquality.conf minlen=12/minclass=3 persisted; live re-test showed weak password rejected (RC=10) and strong password accepted (RC=0) after reboot
